For a relaxing meal that won't require a hike if you are near the convention space, Mohegan Sun Caputo Trattoria in the Casino of the Earth is my top choice. The aroma of their brick-oven pizzas is incredibly comforting, and the casual booths are perfect for sinking into after a long day on your feet. They serve classic Italian favorites like pasta and calzones until 10:00 PM tonight.

Pro tip — their calzones are quite generous in size, making them a great option if you are looking to share a quick bite before heading back to your room.
